win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

wilds.name: JOLT FRAMES
wilds.behavior:
A Jolt Frame can land on a low-paying, high-paying or Wild symbol at the start of a spin and will activate after all wins have been handled on that spin. When a Jolt Frame activates, it spreads out in straight lines and turns all symbols along the lines into the same symbol type as the symbol the Jolt Frame landed on.

 A Jolt Frame can land and spread in two or four directions if there is space, vertically and horizontally, depending on the Jolt Frame that lands.

 A vertical Jolt Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on upwards and downwards to the edge of the grid.

 A horizontal Jolt Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on to the right and left edges of the grid.

 A four-way Jolt Frame will spread from the symbol it landed on upward, downward, right, and left to the edge of the grid.

 When the Jolt Frame has finished spreading, the wins will be awarded from the new Clusters that are formed. If a Jolt Frame spreads over a Wild symbol, an Additive 2x Multiplier is added to that Wild symbol. The Multiplier is then added to the Jolt Frame win. The Wild Multiplier will increase by 2x every time it is hit by a Jolt Frame. If there is more than 1 Wild Multiplier, the Multiplier values will be added and then applied to the entire win. Only 1 Jolt Frame can land at the start of a spin.

wilds.name: CHAIN REACTION
wilds.behavior: If a Jolt Frame spreads over a low-paying, high-paying, or Wild symbol of the same type as the symbol the Jolt Frame landed on, it triggers a Chain Reaction. A Jolt Frame will then appear on the second symbol, which triggers another spread depending on the Jolt Frame that lands. This Chain Reaction can continue until the grid is full.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - GOING BANANAS
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the GRAVITY GROOVE bonus, with 1 Jolt Frame guaranteed on every spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 Jolt Frames cannot land on FS symbols.
